description: Implementation of USB device management including hotplug detection, device info retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and event dispatching within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation
classes.description: Manages USB device detection, information retrieval, driver binding, and event notification within the plugin.

methods.name: libUSBInit
methods.description: Initializes libusb context, registers hotplug callbacks, and starts event handling thread.

methods.name: libUSBClose
methods.description: Cleans up libusb resources and stops event handling thread.

methods.name: libUSBEventsHandlingThread
methods.description: Thread function to handle libusb events.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceAttached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is attached; dispatches device arrival event.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceDetached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is detached; dispatches device removal event.

methods.name: getDeviceSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of a USB device via sysfs.

methods.name: getDevicePathFromDevice
methods.description: Determines device path based on serial number and device info.

methods.name: getUSBDescriptorValue
methods.description: Retrieves string descriptor from device handle.

methods.name: getUSBExtInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Extracts extended device info including language IDs and descriptors.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Populates USBDeviceInfo structure from device descriptor.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Fills USBDevice structure with device details.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for device events.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches device events to registered notifications.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Invokes callback methods for specific device events.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected USB devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfo
methods.description: Gets detailed info for a specific device by name.

methods.name: BindDriver
methods.description: Attaches kernel driver to a device.

methods.name: UnbindDriver
methods.description: Detaches kernel driver from a device.
